answer: In Proof of Agent, identity registration demands cryptographic stake burning scaled superlinearly with network footprint: registering n concurrent entities forces an attacker to burn tokens following a cost function C(n) = k * n^2.5. By routing each validator registration through an intake inlet, economic friction prevents identity spoofing. Base stakes are anchored against real asset baskets like copper reserves, while sybil-slashing rewards redistribute into a lotus pool for honest verifiers, making mass replication exponentially cost-prohibitive.
